name: Kamikaze Lassplanes
source:
Fly and fall for powerful Lassplanes! Discover a hand-crafted anime VN with story-driven arcade shoot-'em-up gameplay. Take part in a romantic story with drama and comedic elements set in a steampunk Kingdom filled with magic and torn by a brutal war. Decide the fate of your country and heart. 

Your choices matter:
    Unlock various endings that will reveal different faces of the characters
    Discover and collect a gallery of beautiful, hand-drawn ecchi illustrations.
    Challenge yourself in Arcade mode and beat records.
    Control the lethal Lassplanes in various missions set in a fully 3D environment.
